roles.name: API Developer
roles.description: Designs and builds the APIs and backend services the UI and integration layers consume — the server-side counterpart to the UI Developer.

roles.name: Accounts Payable Specialist
roles.description: Processes supplier invoices and payment runs; maintains vendor master data and resolves payment exceptions.

roles.name: Chief Audit Executive
roles.description: Leadership role responsible for managing all aspects of the internal audit function (IIA Global Internal Audit Standards definition).

roles.name: Chief Executive Officer
roles.description: Chief executive of the carrier, accountable to the board for strategy and performance across all segments.

roles.name: Claims Examiner
roles.description: Reviews submitted claims and adjuster reports to ensure guidelines were followed before settlement (BLS: examiners review claims after submission).

roles.name: Commercial Lines Underwriter
roles.description: Underwrites commercial P&C risks — evaluates submissions, prices and structures coverage, and decides acceptance within authority (O*NET 13-2053.00).

roles.name: Contact Center Supervisor
roles.description: Supervises a contact-center team — schedules, coaches, and quality-monitors agents against service-level targets.

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.description: Turns operating, claims, and underwriting data into analyses, dashboards, and ad-hoc insights for business decision-makers.

roles.name: Data Scientist
roles.description: Builds statistical and machine-learning models on operating, claims, and underwriting data — the hands-on counterpart to the Data Science Lead.

roles.name: Distribution Specialist
roles.description: Supports distribution channels day to day — onboarding producers, maintaining channel materials, and resolving channel inquiries.

roles.name: Field Claims Adjuster
roles.description: Investigates claims in the field — inspects damage, gathers photos and statements, and compiles the claim report for examiner review (O*NET 13-1031.00 sample title).

roles.name: Legal Counsel
roles.description: Provides day-to-day legal advice to business units, drafts and negotiates contracts, and manages matters with outside counsel.

roles.name: ML Engineer
roles.description: Productionizes and operates machine-learning models — pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and retraining (the MLOps lifecycle).

roles.name: Marketing Manager
roles.description: Plans and executes marketing campaigns across channels; manages budget, agencies, and brand standards.

roles.name: Mobile Developer
roles.description: Builds and maintains the carrier’s mobile applications (policyholder self-service, claims FNOL photo capture, agent tools).

roles.name: Payroll Specialist
roles.description: Runs the payroll cycle — processing, deductions, tax withholding, and reconciliation — alongside benefits administration.

roles.name: Personal Lines Underwriter
roles.description: Underwrites personal auto/property risks — applies guidelines and judgment to applications outside straight-through processing (O*NET 13-2053.00).

roles.name: Procurement Manager
roles.description: Runs sourcing and purchasing — RFPs, vendor selection, contract negotiation, and renewals — in partnership with vendor management.

roles.name: SIU Field Investigator
roles.description: Performs field investigation of suspected fraudulent claims, including surveillance, scene examination, and evidence collection (BLS: investigators often do surveillance work).

roles.name: SIU Manager
roles.description: Leads the Special Investigations Unit — triages fraud referrals and directs investigations of suspected fraudulent or criminal claims activity (BLS).

roles.name: Territory Manager
roles.description: Owns production and agency relationships in an assigned territory — recruits and develops agencies, drives premium growth and profitability.

roles.name: Trader
roles.description: Executes fixed-income and other portfolio trades per portfolio-manager direction and the investment policy statement.

roles.name: UX Designer
roles.description: Designs the user experience of customer, agent, and employee applications — research, journeys, wireframes, and design systems.

roles.name: Vulnerability Management Lead / Security Engineering Lead
